name: font_manager_add_path

provenance.source: Exact .139 uikit font_manager decompilation; the manager hangs off *0x200bd1e8+28 and its registered-path list uses payload size at +24 and head at +28.

notes: Appends a {name, path} entry to the font manager's registry, duplicating both strings; returns the new node, or 0 when the family already resolves to that path. It appends at the TAIL while lookup takes the FIRST name match, so it cannot override an already-registered family on its own - the old entry must be removed first. UI owner thread only, never under the interrupt lock. Affects only font wrappers created afterwards. Device probe pending.
